name: Lunar Silk Observatory
description: A moonlit observatory draped in flowing silk that catches lunar rays, turning them into soft luminescent threads.
prompt: An elegant observatory perched on a cliff, its dome and walls wrapped in flowing silk fabric that glows with moonlight. Silken threads cascade down, catching lunar rays and emitting a gentle silver luminescence. Star‑filled sky, crisp detail, 8k.
caption: Where silk meets starlight, dreams are woven. 🌙✨
